finding: The completion-evidence compiler can declare publication artifacts only under docs/reports/**, although the same closeout contract emits governance-optimization/plan-3x-4x-objective-audit-2026-07-31.json. A legitimate sealed closeout bundle therefore becomes permanently stale after that audit projection changes. Traversal, absolute paths, source files, and undeclared artifacts remain fail-closed. A compiler must be able to seal every output it owns without admitting arbitrary repository files.

The focused contract in tests/cli/runbook-completion-evidence.test.ts now covers the declared governance projection alongside report outputs and durable receipts. The repair keeps the namespace list explicit and requires .json paths.
followUp: Current tests/cli/runbook-completion-evidence.test.ts accepts the explicit governance-optimization JSON projection namespace together with report outputs and durable receipts, while rejecting scripts/compile-runbook-completion-evidence.ts.
